curation: Synthetic examples and expected labels/summaries manually authored for this project; labels were not generated by a model and should be reviewed by the maintainer before representing them as human-verified.

cases.input: I was billed twice for my March subscription. Please reverse one charge.

expected.summary: The customer reports a duplicate March subscription charge and requests a reversal.

cases.notes: Duplicate charge should remain billing, not account.

cases.input: My invoice lists 12 seats, but we only have 9.

expected.summary: The customer says the invoice has three more seats than their team uses.
